Leave fields BLANK ("") if not publicly available. A missing email is CORRECT; a made-up one is a critical failure. Accuracy > count. Compute leadScore 0-100 + leadTier (80-100 no/broken/very-outdated site or no booking where relevant; 60-79 outdated/weak; 40-59 functional-improvable; 20-39 modern; 0-19 excellent). Set verificationStatus (Verified/Partially Verified/Unverified/Needs Review) and sourceUrl (REQUIRED, the exact page).
